pages.text: $(bold)Jade$() names whatever you look at, with its health, contents or progress. Hold $(bold)Shift$() for more. Numpad 0 toggles it.$(br2)$(bold)EMI$() is the recipe book: $(bold)R$() for recipes, $(bold)U$() for uses, $(bold)A$() to favourite, drag to the side to pin. It knows Create, Farmer's Delight, loot tables and enchantments.

$(bold)Create$() ponders with $(bold)W$(). $(bold)Geolosys$() and $(bold)Animania$() give you their own books on first join. Village Recruits is explained in $(l:patchouli:towns/new_towns)Towns & Trade$().$(br2)This almanac links to the others where they exist, and does not repeat them.
